name: Ben-Hadad
bio: This Ben-Hadad, son of Hazael, succeeded his father as king of Syria — a later ruler bearing the same name as the two earlier Syrian kings called Ben-Hadad. Jehoash (Joash), king of Israel, recovered from him the cities Hazael had taken from Jehoahaz, defeating Ben-Hadad three times exactly as Elisha had prophesied on his deathbed (2 Kings 13:24-25).
